summary.zh: 比较所有元素、大量元素、微量元素、基本元素和最基本元素，并查看元素功能与常见物质组成。
summary.en: Compare biological element groups and explore concise element functions and the composition of common substances.

summary.en: Explore prokaryotic DNA replication through relaxation, synchronized unwinding and synthesis, primer formation, Okazaki-fragment maturation and ligation.

summary.en: Explore promoter recognition, transcription-bubble formation, pre-mRNA synthesis, splicing, capping and polyadenylation as one continuous process.

summary.en: Explore ribosome assembly, codon recognition, peptide-bond formation, translocation and translation termination as one continuous process.

summary.en: Explore plant-cell boundaries, nucleus, membrane systems, energy conversion and protein processing.

module.zh: 分子与细胞

module.zh: 分子与细胞

summary.en: Link ion pumps and channels to membrane voltage, comparing subthreshold and suprathreshold stimulation.

summary.en: Explore local currents and bidirectional action potential regeneration in an unmyelinated axon.

summary.en: Explore compound action potentials in a nerve bundle with bipolar extracellular recording and four electrode configurations.

summary.en: Compare predation, parasitism, competition and mutualism with shared time, explicit periodic environments and partner-removal comparisons.

module.zh: 必修一 · 分子与细胞

module.zh: 必修一 · 分子与细胞
